_source.mediumDescriptionWithoutHtml: Lead Site Reliability Engineer Disaster Recovery Automation Location: Bengaluru Work from Office Experience: 10 to15 Years Role Overview: We are seeking an experienced Lead Site Reliability Engineer SRE to lead Disaster Recovery, Resilience Engineering, and Automation initiatives for mission-critical banking applications and cloud platforms. The role focuses on designing and improving DR capabilities, automating operational processes, enhancing platform reliability, and driving operational excellence across AWS and Kubernetes environments. Key Responsibilities: Lead Disaster Recovery planning, DR drills, failoverfailback validation, and Business Continuity activities. Design and implement automation for operational tasks, incident response, deployment, and recovery using scripting and Infrastructure-as-Code. Drive platform reliability, observability, capacity planning, and continuous service improvement across AWS and Kubernetes. Collaborate with Application, Platform, DevOps, and Security teams to improve resilience, reduce MTTR, and eliminate recurring production issues. Define SRE best practices, operational standards, runbooks, and mentor engineering teams. Mandatory Skills AWS EKS, EC2, IAM, VPC, RDS, S3, CloudWatch, Kubernetes EKS, Terraform, CICD, Linux, ShellPython scripting. Disaster Recovery, High Availability, Business Continuity, Incident Problem Management, RCA, Automation, and Observability Dynatrace, Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry. Strong experience with Infrastructure Automation, Production Reliability, and Operational Excellence.

_source.mediumDescriptionWithoutHtml: As the CDP Tech Lead, you will play a pivotal role in shaping and implementing architectural designs for a complete view of our customers within the Customer Data Platform CDP. You will be responsible for leading the deployment of the Adobe CDP solution, finalizing roadmap, and hands-on involvement within the platform. This role will require collaboration with Clients Markets stakeholders to build capabilities for personalization, segmentation, data synchronization, and privacy management, enabling seamless integration with the CDP to drive exponential growth. Key Responsibilities: CDP Platform Leadership: Lead management and administration of the Adobe Real-time CDP and related toolkit. Provide architectural leadership and support for the platform as required by business requirements. Collaborate on the management and optimization of data pipelines to and from Adobe CDP. Source systems will be e.g. Brand websites, D2C, CRM apps, offline campaign datasets etc Provide guidance on segment-building and assist in performing dynamic customer-level analysis. Form Consumers Golden Records in Adobe CDP solutionand enrich the same on an ongoing basis with website user behaviour data etc. Apply customer record de-dup and stitching rules etc to have high quality Consumer Golden Records Diagnose and resolve functional issues efficiently. Manage and maintain overall architecture documentation. Coordinate with privacy and compliance teams on proper handling of consumer PII. Technical Leadership: Develop and maintain effective working relationships with team members, internal partners, and other stakeholders. Interface with specific SMEs and business teams across CRM, MarTech, and AdTech to gather business requirements and define technical architecture for enhanced customer experiences and innovative marketing data solutions. Manage the day-to-day work of onshore and offshore developers, acting as their technical lead and offering solutions as needed. Deliver innovative ideas to solve customer needs. Engage in technical resource planning and level-of-effort estimation to support project scoping, pricing, and planning.
